He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball|Texas Tech Red Raiders]] and the [[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball|Illinois Fighting Illini]]. ==Early life== Shannon was born to Treanette Redding and Terrence Shannon Sr. His father attended training camp with the [[Detroit Pistons]] in 2004.{{cite web |title=Terrence Shannon Jr. |url=https://texastech.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/terrence-shannon--jr-/10144 |website=Texas Tech Red Raiders |access-date=January 4, 2021}} His mother and father separated when he was two years old.{{cite web|url=https://newschannel20.com/resources/pdf/65a7bf7d-0d2a-4e77-a895-c9a36ee4bd65-ShannonTROetcMotion.pdf|title=Shannon TRO Motion}} Shannon has four siblings through his mom and three through his dad. ==High school career== Shannon was interested in basketball from a young age, especially after experiencing a growth spurt early in high school.{{cite web |last1=Langston |first1=Michael |title=Four-star forward T.J. Shannon and family rave about FSU visit |url=https://floridastate.rivals.com/news/rivals150-f-terrence-shannon-family-feel-connection-to-noles-after-visit/printable |website=[[Rivals.com|Rivals]] |access-date=January 2, 2021 |date=June 25, 2018}} He attended [[Lincoln Park High School (Chicago)|Lincoln Park High School]] in [[Chicago]], averaging 15 points, 7.5 rebounds and 2.7 assists per game as a senior.{{cite web |last1=Steeno |first1=Paul |title=From pariah to hot commodity, Shannon's recruiting story has happy ending after slow start |url=https://depauliaonline.com/36185/sports/from-pariah-to-hot-commodity-shannons-recruiting-story-has-happy-ending-after-slow-start/ |website=[[The DePaulia]] |access-date=January 4, 2021 |date=August 16, 2018}} Shannon was also a receiver on the school's [[American football|football]] team.{{cite web |last1=O'Brien |first1=Michael |title=Terrence Shannon's love of football pays off for Lincoln Park |url=https://chicago.suntimes.com/2017/9/14/18496014/terrence-shannon-8217-s-love-of-football-pays-off-for-lincoln-park |website=[[Chicago Sun-Times]] |access-date=January 4, 2021 |date=September 14, 2017}} After having no [[NCAA Division I]] basketball scholarship offers by the end of his senior season, he [[reclassification (education)|reclassified]] to the 2019 class and moved to [[IMG Academy]] in [[Bradenton, Florida]].{{cite web |last1=Henricksen |first1=Joe |title=Lincoln Park's Terrence Shannon commits to DePaul |url=https://chicago.suntimes.com/2018/8/12/18498268/depaul-lands-late-blooming-lincoln-park-star-terrence-shannon |website=[[Chicago Sun-Times]] |access-date=January 4, 2021 |date=August 12, 2018}} ===Recruiting=== His success with Mac Irvin Fire on the [[Amateur Athletic Union]] circuit drew attention from many college programs.{{cite web |last1=Snow |first1=Brian |title=Shannon sees recruitment explode this spring |url=https://247sports.com/college/basketball/recruiting/Article/A-strong-spring-has-made-the-recruitment-of-athletic-wing-Terrence-Shannon-explode-118146991/ |website=[[247Sports.com|247Sports]] |access-date=January 4, 2021 |date=May 11, 2018}} A four-star [[college recruiting|recruit]], he originally committed to [[DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball|DePaul]] before switching his commitment to [[Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball|Texas Tech]].{{cite web |last1=Rose |first1=Aaron |title=Four-star prospect Shannon endures long road, commits to Texas Tech |url=https://www.lubbockonline.com/sports/20190311/four-star-prospect-shannon-endures-long-road-commits-to-texas-tech |website=[[Lubbock Avalanche-Journal]] |access-date=January 4, 2021 |date=March 11, 2019}} He chose the Red Raiders over offers from DePaul, [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State]], [[Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball|Georgetown]] and [[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball|Illinois]].{{cite web |last1=Golan |first1=Ben |title=Top 60 Wing Terrence Shannon Jr. commits to Texas Tech |url=https://texastech.rivals.com/news/top-60-wing-terrence-shannon-jr-commits-to-texas-tech |website=[[Rivals.com|Rivals]] |access-date=January 4, 2021 |date=March 11, 2019}} ==College career== ===Texas Tech (2019–2022)=== ====2019–20: Freshman season==== Shannon entered his [[2019–20 Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball team|freshman season]] as one of Texas Tech's starting [[Point guard|guards]]. On December 4, 2019, Shannon recorded a freshman season-high 24 points and eight rebounds in a 65–60 overtime loss to DePaul.{{cite web |last1=Silva Jr. |first1=Carlos |title=Tech's Shannon shows out in return to hometown |url=https://www.lubbockonline.com/sports/20191207/techs-shannon-shows-out-in-return-to-hometown |website=[[Lubbock Avalanche-Journal]] |access-date=January 2, 2021 |date=December 7, 2019}} As a freshman, he averaged 9.8 points and 4.1 [[Rebound (basketball)|rebounds]] per game, earning [[Big 12 Conference]] All-Freshman Team honors.{{cite web |last1=Mainville |first1=Ryan |title=Terrence Shannon Jr. placed on Julius Erving Award Watch List |url=http://www.dailytoreador.com/sports/terrence-shannon-jr-placed-on-julius-erving-award-watch-list/article_b34dd4f0-1ed3-11eb-a0bb-0f6f537b0c3f.html |website=[[The Daily Toreador]] |access-date=January 2, 2021 |date=November 4, 2020}} ====2020–21: Sophomore season==== Entering his [[2020–21 Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball team|sophomore season]], Shannon was named to the [[Julius Erving Award]] watch list.{{cite web |last1=Silva Jr. |first1=Carlos |title=Sophomore guard Shannon, Jr. garners award, Texas Tech releases nonconference schedule |url=https://www.lubbockonline.com/story/sports/college/red-raiders/2020/11/04/shannon-garners-award-texas-tech-releases-nonconference-schedule/6164582002/ |website=[[Lubbock Avalanche-Journal]] |access-date=January 2, 2021 |date=November 4, 2020}} On January 30, 2021, Shannon registered his first career [[double-double]] with 23 points and 10 rebounds against [[2020–21 LSU Tigers men's basketball team|LSU]]. Going into the [[2021 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]], the Red Raiders were 9–8 in the Big 12, good enough to earn the 6-seed. During their quarterfinal matchup against [[2020–21 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team|Texas]], Shannon played 34 minutes making four [[three-point field goals]] in way of an 18-point outing. Despite his performance, Texas Tech was eliminated by a score of 67–66. The Red Raiders were then granted the 6-seed in the South Region of the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]]. In their Round of 32 matchup against [[2020–21 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team|Arkansas]], Shannon scored 20 points despite the Red Raiders being eliminated. As a sophomore, Shannon averaged 12.9 points, four rebounds, 1.4 [[Assist (basketball)|assists]], and 1.1 [[Steal (basketball)|steals]] per game. For his efforts, he earned Third-team All-Big 12 honors. On April 8, 2021, Shannon declared for the [[2021 NBA draft]] while maintaining his college eligibility.{{cite web |last=Nash |first=Branson |title=Texas Tech wing Terrence Shannon declares for NBA draft, doesn't sign agent |url=https://www.dallasnews.com/sports/texas-tech-red-raiders/2021/04/08/terrence-shannon-declares-for-the-nba-draft-does-not-sign-with-an-agent/ |website=[[The Dallas Morning News]] |access-date=June 16, 2021 |date=April 8, 2021}} He ultimately returned to Texas Tech for a third season. ====2021–22: Junior season==== On November 7, Shannon was suspended indefinitely due to an eligibility review.{{cite news |last1=Borzello |first1=Jeff |title=Texas Tech's Terrence Shannon Jr. out indefinitely during eligibility review |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/32577851/texas-tech-terrence-shannon-jr-indefinitely-eligibility-review |access-date=November 10, 2021 |work=[[ESPN]] |date=November 7, 2021}} He was reinstated on November 17, after missing three games.{{cite news |title=Texas Tech clears Terrence Shannon Jr. to resume playing in basketball games after eligibility review |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/32654840/texas-tech-clears-terrence-shannon-jr-return-eligibility-review |access-date=November 18, 2021 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=November 17, 2021}} As a junior, he averaged 10.4 points, 2.6 rebounds, and two assists per game. On March 25, 2022, Shannon entered the [[NCAA transfer portal]].{{Cite web |last=Geoghegan |first=Zack |date=March 25, 2022|title=Texas Tech's Terrence Shannon Jr. in transfer portal, hears from Kentucky |url=https://www.on3.com/teams/kentucky-wildcats/news/texas-techs-terrence-shannon-jr-in-transfer-portal-hears-from-kentucky/|access-date=April 29, 2022 |website=On3.com |language=en}} ===Illinois (2022–2024)=== ====2022–23: Senior season==== On April 29, 2022, he committed to [[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball|Illinois]].{{cite web|title=Terrence Shannon Jr. is transferring to Illinois |url=https://www.kcbd.com/2022/04/29/terrence-shannon-jr-is-transferring-illinois/ |website=KCBD.com |access-date=April 29, 2022 |date=April 29, 2021}} After his first season at Illinois, he declared for the [[2023 NBA draft]] and played in the NBA draft combine. He later withdrew from the draft and returned to Illinois for a second season and his fifth season overall. ====2023–24: Graduate season==== Shannon played 11 games for the Illini before being suspended for six games, Shannon was considered a front-runner for the [[List of U.S. men's college basketball national player of the year awards|National Player of the Year award]] before his suspension.{{Cite web |last=Hochman |first=Benjamin |date=2023-12-24 |title=Hochman: Is Illinois' Terrence Shannon Jr. one of nation's best players? MU's Gates says so. |url=https://www.stltoday.com/sports/column/benjamin-hochman/hochman-is-illinois-terrence-shannon-jr-one-of-nation-s-best-players-mu-s-gates/article_b8a6163c-a1df-11ee-8ef3-07b554dbeac8.html |access-date=2024-06-14 |website=STLtoday.com |language=en}} After a preliminary injunction was granted, his suspension was ended and he resumed playing the rest of the season. Following the season's end and the Not Guilty verdict, it was announced that Shannon's jersey would be honored by the University.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/illinois/article/illinois-fighting-illini-basketball-terrence-shannon-jr-honored-jersey-rafters-josh-whitman-233059051/ |title=Whitman: Illini will raise Terrence || .347 || .793 || 3.9 || 1.9 || 1.0 || .4 || 15.0 {{S-end}} ==Personal life== ===Rape allegations=== In the early morning of Saturday, September 9, 2023 (following the prior day's Kansas-Illinois football game), Shannon allegedly penetrated a woman with his fingers at the Jayhawk Cafe.{{cite web|url=https://writingillini.com/posts/sworn-affidavit-filed-in-the-state-of-kansas-vs-terrence-shannon-jr-case |title=Sworn affidavit filed in the State of Kansas vs Terrence Shannon Jr. Case |date=January 9, 2024 }} Months later, on December 27, Shannon was arrested on a warrant issued by the Douglas County (Kansas) District Attorney for the charge of rape; sexual intercourse without consent, and use of force against a victim.{{cite news|url=https://www2.ljworld.com/news/public-safety/2023/dec/28/illinois-basketball-player-arrested-on-suspicion-of-rape-in-lawrence/|title=Illinois basketball player arrested on suspicion of rape in Lawrence|publisher=Lawrence Journal-World|date=December 28, 2023|accessdate=December 28, 2023}}{{cite news|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/39198787/illinois-terrence-shannon-jr-charged-rape-suspended|title=Illinois' Terrence Shannon Jr. charged with rape, suspended|first=Myron|last=Metcalf|publisher=ESPN|date=December 28, 2023|access-date=December 28, 2023}} Shannon posted bail the following day and was suspended by the team.{{cite web|url=https://khqa.com/newsletter-daily/illinois-basketballs-terrance-shannon-jr-suspended-faces-rape-charges-in-kansas|title=Illinois basketball's Terrance Shannon Jr. suspended, faces rape charges in Kansas|date=December 28, 2023|first=Collin|last=Cramer}} No bar employees, security staff, friends, or roommates other than the accuser's best friend were interviewed.{{cite web|url=https://www.wcia.com/top-stories/opening-arguments-heard-in-terrence-shannon-jr-criminal-rape-trial/|title=Opening statements heard in Terrence Shannon Jr. criminal rape trial}} The police took surveillance footage from the Jayhawk Cafe, however, the spot where the alleged crime took place occurred off-camera. The accuser's drinking the night of the incident also varied between what she told the police and what was filed in her sexual assault exam report, but the police did not seek receipts to verify.{{cite web|url=https://lawrencekstimes.com/2024/06/11/shannon-trial-day-2/|title=Defense questions depth of police investigation during rape trial for Illinois basketball player}} After completing the sexual assault exam the following day, the accuser and her friend returned to the Jayhawk Cafe, one night after the incident took place.{{cite web|url=https://www.wcia.com/news/who-has-testified-in-terrence-shannon-jr-s-trial/|title=Who has testified in Terrence Shannon Jr.'s trial?}} Kansas players [[Kevin McCullar Jr.]] and [[Hunter Dickinson]], as well as Graduate Assistant Dyshawn Hobson and Illini player [[Justin Harmon]] testified that they did not witness Shannon interact with any women the night of the incident.{{cite web|url=https://www.chicagotribune.com/2024/06/12/at-rape-trial-of-illinois-basketball-star-terrence-shannon-jury-hears-from-accusers-friend-kansas-player/|title=At rape trial of Illinois basketball star Terrence Shannon, jury hears from accuser's friend, other players|website=[[Chicago Tribune]] }} Following a series of back-and-forth legal actions between Shannon and the University,{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/39268879/terrence-shannon-jr-files-restraining-order-illinois|title=Terrence Shannon files for restraining order against Illinois|date=January 9, 2024|first=Myron|last=Medcalf}} on January 19, Shannon was granted a preliminary injunction against the University of Illinois, thus making him eligible to play.{{cite web|url=https://news.wttw.com/2024/01/20/judge-ends-suspension-illinois-basketball-star-terrence-shannon-jr-who-faces-rape-charge|title=Judge Ends Suspension of Illinois Basketball Star Terrence Shannon Jr., Who Faces Rape Charge}} The University ultimately dropped its investigation with Shannon dropping his lawsuit as a result.{{cite web|url=https://www.wcia.com/top-stories/u-of-i-drops-investigation-of-shannon-jr-takes-no-disciplinary-action/ |title=U of I drops investigation of Terrence Shannon Jr., takes no disciplinary action |date=April 10, 2024 }} On May 2, the DNA results were released through a hearing by Shannon's defense. Most of the DNA samples were unusable and one sample contained a mixture of at least three males, none of whom were Shannon.{{cite web|url=https://www.wcia.com/sports/your-illini-nation/terrence-shannon-jr-s-attorneys-file-motion-to-exclude-states-dna-testing-in-criminal-case/|title=Terrence Shannon Jr.'s attorneys file motion to exclude state's DNA testing in criminal case|date=May 2, 2024 }} On June 7, Shannon's defense successfully motioned to include evidence of a third-party incident committed by Arterio Morris, who allegedly sexually assaulted a woman at the Jayhawk Cafe less than two weeks prior to the alleged incident involving Shannon. On June 10, jury selection took place with a jury of eight men and seven women selected to serve as the 12 jurors and three alternates.{{cite web|url=https://lawrencekstimes.com/2024/06/10/shannon-trial-day-1/ |title=Jury trial of Illinois basketball player accused of raping woman at Lawrence bar set to begin Tuesday }} During the trial, the accuser testified that Shannon grabbed her wrist when previously she had said no such grabbing occurred as her hands were occupied by her phone and drink. The accuser's friend corroborated the grabbing, despite not mentioning it in previous testimony. The accuser in a group chat with her friends after ESPN released the story of Shannon’s charges on December 28, 2023. Friend: (ESPN article link shared) OMG Best friend: You got him Accuser: YUPPP YESSSIRR Friend: Got his ass 🤑🤑 On June 13, Shannon was acquitted on both charges.{{Cite web|last1=Mittal |first1=Sahil |date=2024-06-13 |title=Not guilty: Illinois star Terrence Shannon Jr. acquitted by jury in rape case |url=https://dailyillini.com/sports-stories/mens-sports/men-basketball/2024/06/13/not-guilty-illinois-star-terrence-shannon-jr-acquitted-by-jury-in-rape-case/ |access-date=2024-06-16 |website=The Daily Illini}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://fightingillini.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/terrence-shannon-jr-/13959 Illinois Fighting Illini bio] *[https://texastech.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/terrence-shannon--jr-/10144 Texas Tech Red Raiders bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Shannon, Terrence Jr.}} [[Category:2000 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:All-American college men's basketball players]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Chicago]] [[Category:Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball players]] [[Category:IMG Academy alumni]] [[Category:Shooting guards]] [[Category:Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball players]]
